metadata.purpose: Why does a vertical scrollbar appear in the Sub-Menus left panel after clicking a top-menu item?
metadata.context: After clicking Seguridad Otros (top toolbar), the left panel shows Sub-Menus with a vertical scrollbar. Investigating container dimensions, overflow settings, item count, and layout constraints.

steps.label: Fail fast if login did not reach the app
Wait for left menu to settle after top-menu click
Deep probe: left panel scroll geometry and all menu items
steps.name: scrollbarProbe
steps.script: return (() => { function elInfo(sel, label) { const e = typeof sel === 'string' ? document.querySelector(sel) : sel; if (!e) return { label, exists: false }; const cs = getComputedStyle(e); const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { label, exists: true, id: e.id || null, tag: e.tagName.toLowerCase(), className: String(e.className || '').slice(0, 200), overflow: cs.overflow, overflowY: cs.overflowY, overflowX: cs.overflowX, height: cs.height, maxHeight: cs.maxHeight, clientHeight: e.clientHeight, scrollHeight: e.scrollHeight, scrollTop: e.scrollTop, hasVerticalScroll: e.scrollHeight > e.clientHeight, boundingRect: { x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) }, childCount: e.children.length }; } const leftPanel = document.querySelector('[id*="layoutmain-West"]') || document.querySelector('[id*="layout-West"]'); const menuSearchPanel = document.getElementById('gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenusearch-Center'); const menuPanel = document.getElementById('gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenu-Center'); const treeContainer = document.getElementById('W0047W0003GXUI_TREEVIEW1Container'); const menuContainer = document.getElementById('W0047W0003GXUI_MENU1Container'); const allMenuRows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.x-grid-row, .x-tree-node, [id*="gxui"] li, [id*="MENU"] .x-grid-row')]; const subMenusLabel = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.innerText && e.innerText.trim() === 'Sub-Menús'); const subMenusContainer = subMenusLabel ? steps.label: Walk up scroll-ancestor chain from menu rows
steps.name: scrollAncestors
steps.script: return (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('[id*="layoutmenusearch-Center"] .x-grid-row, [id*="layoutmenu-Center"] .x-grid-row, [id*="MENU"] .x-grid-row'); const firstRow = rows[0]; if (!firstRow) return { error: 'no menu rows found', allIds: [...document.querySelectorAll('[id]')].filter(e => e.id.toLowerCase().includes('menu') || e.id.toLowerCase().includes('sub')).map(e => e.id).slice(0, 50) }; const ancestors = []; let el = firstRow; while (el && el !== document.body && ancestors.length < 20) { const cs = getComputedStyle(el); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); ancestors.push({ id: el.id || null, tag: el.tagName.toLowerCase(), className: String(el.className || '').slice(0, 80), overflow: cs.overflow, overflowY: cs.overflowY, height: cs.height, clientHeight: el.clientHeight, scrollHeight: el.scrollHeight, isScrollContainer: el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight && (cs.overflowY === 'auto' || cs.overflowY === 'scroll'), boundW: Math.round(r.width), boundH: Math.round(r.height) }); el = el.parentElement; } return { firstRowText: (firstRow.innerText || '').trim(), ancestors }; })();

steps.label: Get all menu items with bounding rects to see which are off-screen
steps.name: menuItemPositions
